name: V1_1_PROJECTED_SEMANTIC_DEBT_KERNEL
purpose: Track exact witness-reconstruction obligations through reversible normalization, existential projection, decomposition and local proof-carrying discharge, while preventing representation changes or variable elimination from being misreported as semantic progress.

source_problem.X: Original existential/witness variables whose values must eventually be reconstructible on the exact domain.
source_problem.B: External/boundary variables retained by the interface.
source_problem.closed_instance_note: For a closed SAT instance, B is empty and D_0 is a Boolean constant.

kernel_state.notation: S = (F0_id, R, Z, D, V_live, V_debt, V_cert, Omega, Pi, q, rho)

components.F0_id: Content-addressed identity of the frozen original relation F_0.
components.R: Current exact projected relation R(Z,B) represented by a typed exact carrier.
components.Z: Current live semantic variables in the projected relation. They may use a reversible carrier/basis representation but remain tied to original witness obligations through q.
components.D: Exact current boundary domain D(B) := exists Z R(Z,B).
components.V_live: Original witness-variable obligations not yet projected away.
components.V_debt: Original witness-variable obligations projected away but not yet equipped with an accepted reconstruction rule or certified vacuity/irrelevance proof.
components.V_cert: Original witness-variable obligations already equipped with accepted reconstruction objects or a certified proof that no reconstruction choice is required on the exact domain.
components.Omega: Ordered/DAG collection of reconstruction obligations generated by projection steps.
components.Pi: Accepted proof objects, including witness rules, domain proofs, recomposition proofs and terminal replay certificates.
components.q: Reversible quotient/carrier map connecting the current representation to the represented live semantic state.
components.rho: Optional content-addressed route/cache references. They have no proof authority until revalidated.

accounting_invariant.partition: The original witness-variable obligation set X is partitioned disjointly as X = V_live dot_union V_debt dot_union V_cert.
accounting_invariant.debt_weight: Debt is counted by original witness obligations, not by current syntactic variables, aliases, carrier coordinates or DAG node count.
accounting_invariant.key_effect: A reversible representation change leaves the partition unchanged. Exact projection moves obligations from V_live to V_debt and therefore leaves P unchanged. Only accepted discharge moves obligations from V_debt to V_cert and increases P.
accounting_invariant.scope: This is an accounting invariant over original reconstruction obligations. It is not Shannon entropy, information dimension, circuit complexity or a claim that original variables are semantically independent.

obligation_object.notation: delta = (pre_id, post_id, E, Y, D_post, dependency_contract, status)
obligation_object.meaning: A projection receipt saying that variables/obligations E were removed when moving from pre-relation R_pre(E,Y,B) to post-relation R_post(Y,B)=exists E R_pre(E,Y,B).

required_fields.pre_id: Hash/identity of the exact pre-projection carrier/relation.
required_fields.post_id: Hash/identity of the exact post-projection carrier/relation.
required_fields.E: Projected original witness obligations or a block tied unambiguously to them.
required_fields.Y: Surviving live variables on which a reconstruction rule may depend at this stage.
required_fields.D_post: Exact domain of the post-state relevant to the conditional witness obligation.
required_fields.dependency_contract: Permitted inputs of any reconstruction function for E; must obey original dependency discipline.

obligation_object.witness_discharge_condition: Supply f_E(Y,B) plus a locally accepted proof pi_E of D_post(B) AND R_post(Y,B) => R_pre(f_E(Y,B),Y,B).
obligation_object.vacuity_discharge_condition: Supply a locally accepted proof that on the exact reachable post-domain no choice for E is required, e.g. the post-domain is false or all permitted values of E are extension-equivalent for reconstruction purposes.
obligation_object.provenance_rule: Discharging removes the obligation from the live debt set but never deletes the historical projection receipt or its proof provenance.

REVERSIBLE_NORMALIZE.precondition: A locally checkable exact bijection/isomorphism between current carrier representatives is supplied.
REVERSIBLE_NORMALIZE.state_effect: R/q representation may change; V_live, V_debt, V_cert and Omega statuses remain unchanged.
REVERSIBLE_NORMALIZE.forbidden: Aliases, XOR basis changes, DAG rewrites or equivalent reparameterizations may not claim certified progress.
REVERSIBLE_NORMALIZE.collision_certificate_role: A local semantic collision witness (b0,b1,w) with b0 != b1, q(b0)=q(b1), and distinguishable continuation semantics is a rejection certificate showing that the proposed map is not a safe reversible normalization. Absence of such a collision is not by itself a proof of bijectivity.

PROJECT.precondition: Exact proof/certificate that R_post(Y,B) iff exists E R_pre(E,Y,B).
PROJECT.state_effect: Move the associated original obligations E from V_live to V_debt; append projection receipt delta to Omega; update R and D exactly.
PROJECT.debt_rule: Projection transfers obligation; it never erases it.
PROJECT.forbidden: A projected variable may not be silently counted as solved, reconstructed, irrelevant or progress-positive merely because it disappeared syntactically.

DISCHARGE_WITNESS.precondition: For one or more undischarged obligations, provide a frozen-calculus witness rule plus local proof satisfying the obligation's dependency and exact-domain contract.
DISCHARGE_WITNESS.state_effect: Move the covered obligations from V_debt to V_cert; attach the witness/proof object to Pi and Omega.
DISCHARGE_WITNESS.progress_effect: P increases exactly by the number of newly certified original obligations.

DISCHARGE_VACUITY.precondition: A locally accepted exact proof that the obligation is irrelevant/vacuous on the reachable exact domain.
DISCHARGE_VACUITY.state_effect: Move the covered obligations from V_debt to V_cert with status VACUITY_CERTIFIED.
DISCHARGE_VACUITY.progress_effect: P increases for the closed obligations.
DISCHARGE_VACUITY.note: This route must not be used to totalize a partial domain or to infer irrelevance from lack of a found witness.

DECOMPOSE.precondition: Exact factorization/separator/carrier theorem plus a proved recomposition contract and partition-consistent debt routing.
DECOMPOSE.state_effect: May replace one state by a portfolio/DAG of substates whose exact conjunction/disjunction semantics and reconstruction composition are certified.
DECOMPOSE.progress_effect: No progress merely from splitting. Progress is the sum of newly certified original obligations after deduplicating shared/provenance-identical obligations.
DECOMPOSE.requirement: The recomposed portfolio must preserve one authoritative partition of original obligations.

RECOMPOSE.precondition: All required child interfaces and their recomposition proofs are present.
RECOMPOSE.state_effect: Construct parent exact domain/witness objects and merge debt/certification provenance without double counting.
RECOMPOSE.progress_effect: Only obligations actually certified in children may appear in V_cert.

ROUTE_REUSE.precondition: Content-addressed source identity matches and the cached route is revalidated against the current canonical state.
ROUTE_REUSE.state_effect: May propose/replay a legal sequence of transformations.
ROUTE_REUSE.progress_effect: None until the individual replayed transitions pass their current verifiers.
ROUTE_REUSE.forbidden: Cached SAT/UNSAT verdicts or stale proof results have no authority by themselves.

TERMINATE_OPEN_INTERFACE.precondition: V_live is empty, V_debt is empty, exact D is closed, all required witness/reconstruction objects are present in Pi, and the composed witness replays against F_0 on D.
TERMINATE_OPEN_INTERFACE.output: (D, f_X, pi_D, pi_f) for the original relation F_0(X,B).
TERMINATE_OPEN_INTERFACE.theorem_target: pi_D certifies D(B) iff exists X F_0(X,B); pi_f certifies D(B) => F_0(f_X(B),B).

TERMINATE_CLOSED_SAT_UNSAT.SAT: For B empty and D_0=TRUE, require V_live=V_debt=empty, reconstruct a full original assignment, and replay it on frozen F_0.
TERMINATE_CLOSED_SAT_UNSAT.UNSAT: For B empty and D_0=FALSE, require an independent exact false-domain/UNSAT certificate. Remaining witness obligations may be closed only by explicit vacuity certification under the false domain.
TERMINATE_CLOSED_SAT_UNSAT.forbidden: No terminal result may be justified only by an internal reduced-state verdict without source replay/certificate.

T1_PARTITION_CONSERVATION.statement: Every accepted transition preserves the disjoint partition X = V_live dot_union V_debt dot_union V_cert.

T2_REVERSIBLE_ZERO_PROGRESS.proof_plan: The transition changes only the representative/carrier q,R and preserves all obligation-status sets.

T3_PROJECTION_DEBT_TRANSFER.statement: For an exact projection of k previously live original obligations, |V_live| decreases by k and |V_debt| increases by k, while P remains unchanged.
T3_PROJECTION_DEBT_TRANSFER.proof_plan: Directly from PROJECT transition typing and partition conservation.

T4_SOUND_WITNESS_DISCHARGE.statement: If an obligation delta is discharged by f_E with accepted proof D_post AND R_post => R_pre(f_E,...), then every post-state solution on the exact domain can be extended through that projection step.
T4_SOUND_WITNESS_DISCHARGE.proof_plan: One-step semantic implication; multi-step reconstruction follows by reverse topological composition of discharged obligations.

T5_TERMINAL_RECONSTRUCTION.statement: If an open-interface terminal state is accepted with V_live=V_debt=empty, then its composed f_X is a valid conditional Skolem map for F_0 on the certified exact domain D.
T5_TERMINAL_RECONSTRUCTION.proof_plan: Induction backwards through the ordered/DAG projection receipts using T4 and exact recomposition contracts.

T6_TERMINAL_CLOSED_SOUNDNESS.statement: An accepted closed SAT terminal replays to a satisfying assignment of F_0; an accepted closed UNSAT terminal has an independently checkable certificate that D_0=FALSE.
T6_TERMINAL_CLOSED_SOUNDNESS.proof_plan: SAT from T5 plus replay; UNSAT from exact domain certificate.

T7_SCHEDULER_NON_AUTHORITY.statement: If the scheduler may choose only among transitions whose legality is independently verified, changing the scheduler can change search order/performance/completeness-in-practice but cannot by itself change the soundness of accepted terminal states.
T7_SCHEDULER_NON_AUTHORITY.proof_plan: Soundness composes from transition verifiers and is independent of proposal provenance.

T8_ROUTE_CACHE_NON_AUTHORITY.statement: A cached route has no semantic authority until replayed transitions are revalidated on the exact current state.
T8_ROUTE_CACHE_NON_AUTHORITY.proof_plan: By ROUTE_REUSE definition; cached data are proposal metadata rather than accepted proof nodes.

proof_carrying_interface.rationale: D/f/pi already have public analogues; Omega_closed is the explicit audit trail showing how every original reconstruction obligation was transferred and discharged.

SAT_reconstruction_stacks.overlap: SAT preprocessing variable elimination and related equisatisfiable simplifications store eliminated clauses/witnesses on reconstruction stacks so models of the simplified formula can be lifted to models of the original.
SAT_reconstruction_stacks.consequence: The broad idea 'elimination creates a later reconstruction obligation' is not claimed novel.
SAT_reconstruction_stacks.difference_candidate: Debt Kernel promotes reconstruction status to an explicit global proof-accounting partition and forbids projection itself from counting as progress.

MRes_building_strategies_into_QBF_proofs.overlap: Partial strategies are semantic objects attached to proof lines and are piecewise constructed by local inference rules; soundness is maintained through line invariants.
MRes_building_strategies_into_QBF_proofs.consequence: The broad idea 'build witness/strategy objects locally along a proof' is not claimed novel.
MRes_building_strategies_into_QBF_proofs.difference_candidate: Debt Kernel is organized around exact existential projection receipts, reversible-zero-progress governance, separate domain certificates, and a live/debt/certified obligation ledger rather than a specific QBF resolution calculus.

certified_projected_knowledge_compilatio.overlap: Projected compilation explicitly eliminates existential variables while carrying Skolem assignments and machine-checkable/formally verified certificates for the projected result.
certified_projected_knowledge_compilatio.consequence: Projection + Skolem reconstruction + certification is not claimed novel.
certified_projected_knowledge_compilatio.difference_candidate: Debt Kernel is intended as a solver-independent transition/accounting layer spanning heterogeneous exact carriers and arbitrary proposal policies, with projection/debt/discharge conservation made explicit.

SynQBF.overlap: A proof system can encode enough semantic information to extract Skolem/Herbrand functions and intermediate game values efficiently.
SynQBF.consequence: Proof-carrying function extraction is not claimed novel.
SynQBF.difference_candidate: The open comparison is whether debt receipts/local discharge certificates translate to/from SynQBF proof obligations with polynomial overhead without free generic equivalence checking.

strongest_remaining_combination: Explicit quotient rule: exact reversible re-encoding is formally zero certified progress.
Exact projection changes obligation status LIVE -> DEBT rather than counting elimination as progress.
Certified progress is tied to DEBT -> CERTIFIED, not syntactic variable disappearance.
Exact domain D is maintained separately from reconstruction witnesses.
A heterogeneous typed-carrier solver can share one obligation ledger across affine, 2CNF, separator, factor and general DAG lanes.
Learned/portfolio/swarm policies may propose moves but cannot alter legality, debt accounting or terminal authority.
Cached routes are revalidated and never import verdict authority.
Agent/proposal multiplicity cannot create proof authority.

not_yet_defined: A complete operational semantics for all typed carriers.
A completeness theorem for the transition system.
A proof-system p-simulation theorem against SynQBF/M-Res/SCPOG.
formalization_limits.deliberately_avoided: No entropy/information metric is used as certified progress; the kernel tracks original reconstruction obligations exactly instead.

next_theory_work.priority_1: Prove T1-T5 for the abstract transition system independently of any heuristic scheduler.
next_theory_work.priority_2: Instantiate PROJECT and DISCHARGE on the already-frozen V1.1 controls and verify that their existing artifacts can be reinterpreted as debt receipts without rerunning experiments.
next_theory_work.priority_3: Define a translation interface between Omega/pi objects and SynQBF or SCPOG certificate fragments; measure proof-size and checking overhead.
next_theory_work.priority_4: Only after theorem/proir-art review decide whether the kernel merits a standalone algorithm implementation.
